subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` transforms permanently replace canonical user transcript text for every plugin transform?
rationale: The PR adds a public plugin outcome and changes the durable meaning of user-authored session history; implementation correctness cannot determine that permanent product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Canonical transcript transform
options.body: Adopt transform as a redaction contract whose replacement becomes canonical across model input, transcript persistence, diagnostics, and lifecycle hooks.

options.title: Separate transform modes
options.body: Expose distinct model-only and canonical-history transform semantics so plugin authors explicitly choose persistence behavior.

options.title: Keep pass/block only
options.body: Do not add transform until a narrower sanitization owner and durable-history contract are designed.

recommendation.title: Canonical transcript transform
recommendation.body: Adopt transform as a redaction contract whose replacement becomes canonical across model input, transcript persistence, diagnostics, and lifecycle hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest merged decision on the adjacent CLI transcript and reseed boundary was routed through this merger.
